Yes, most likely. Pots and planters can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they're unused and in their original packaging. At 3 weeks you should still be inside the window, since it runs from delivery rather than purchase.

For a change-of-mind return, a flat $6.95 fee is deducted, so you'd get back **$23.05** of the $30 (the fee is only waived for Leafy Plus members). Original shipping isn't refunded unless the whole order is returned because of our error.

Start the return from "My Orders". A prepaid label will be emailed to you, and you'll need to drop the parcel off within 7 days before it expires. Your refund goes to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse.
